name: Stage 29: Viggaren to Djupviksvägen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 29, Viggaren to Djupviksvägen.
utilities: Official distance is 9.5 km from Viggaren to Djupviksvägen. Naturkartan also lists 9.5 km but its prose says about 9 km, OSM relation 3114035 is tagged 9 km and measures about 9.4 km, the local official-GPX-derived line is about 9.1 km, and Äventyrligare reports about 9.24 km; keep 9.5 km as canonical.

Expect a moderate mixed forest/lake stage with old infields, Mossängen old-forest context, Hjulbo/Hålvetten bathing opportunity, climbs after Hjulbo, a viewpoint before Näsnaren, then Näsnaren/Fagerön facilities.

Näsnaren shelter has the key trail overnight cluster: shelter, fireplace, dry toilet, nearby official source, bathing/rest context, and suitable tenting. Reports suggest hammock use is easier than tenting and there may only be room for about one tent.

Fagerön is the best service node near the end: municipal bathing place, shelter/Arknat context, toilets, grill/fireplace, benches/tables, bins, jetty, and nearby parking. It is still a day-use public beach setting, not a serviced campsite.

Nearby off-route services include Fridhem Outdoor near Hjulbo/Näsnaren/Fagerön, listed by Sörmlandsleden with lodging/food/sauna/canoe by arrangement, and Djupviks kursgård context near the next-stage access. Verify bookings/current operation before relying on either.

Public transport is weak. OSM and regional maps show Fagerön, Djupviksnäs, Djupvik, Källvik vägskäl and Nytorp contexts, and bus 483/Djupvik-Katrineholm or Strångsjö-Djupvik material, but service is sparse; check Sörmlandstrafiken live before planning a transit-only hike.
waterSources: Two official natural water points are mapped: the mid-stage source at 58.852317, 16.331217 and the Näsnaren source at 58.838150, 16.327650. Both should be treated/filtered/boiled; Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee availability or quality.

Fagerön and Näsnaren lake water are bathing/natural water contexts, not potable taps. Fagerön bathing samples in 2025 were tjänligt with no algal bloom, and the 2026-season classification is excellent; this is bathing-water context, not drinking-water approval.

Näsnaren has a PFAS/PFOS fish-consumption warning from Katrineholm/Länsstyrelsen; official advice is not to eat fish from the lake. Treat this as a fish-consumption warning, not a published bathing closure, but do not rely on Näsnaren lake water as casual drinking water. Ordinary boiling/filtering for microbes should not be presented as PFAS treatment.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official page showed no current fault reports for stage 29 during the 2026-04-27 research pass. The stage-30 bark-beetle/windfall warning starts beyond this stage and matters only if continuing south.

Official suitable tent spots are Fagerön and by the Näsnaren shelter. Katrineholm's local public-order rules classify Fagerön bathing place as public place and restrict camping on public places, so do not present the municipal beach/lawn as a tent site; use posted signs and only low-impact allemansrätt ground clearly outside restricted public bathing-place areas.

Use established fireplaces only and check current fire restrictions/brandrisk before lighting. Sörmlandsleden says shelter fireplaces do not guarantee firewood, Fagerön has no verified firewood supply, and VSR had no formal Katrineholm/Vingåker ban at check time but advised against outdoor fires/grilling in nature because it was dry/high risk.

Fagerön is a Katrineholm municipal bathing place; smoking and dogs are prohibited at ordinary municipal bathing areas according to Naturkartan/Katrineholm guidance, and dogs must be leashed on public places.

Sörmlandsleden says a site-specific Arknat shelter opened near Fagerön on 2025-07-09. The separate Arknat/Hefna website coordinate appears far from Fagerön/Näsnaren and should not be used for navigation; use Sörmlandsleden/map signage and treat it as bridge/Fagerön context.
There is no parking exactly where stage 29 becomes stage 30. Use the bridge/Fagerön parking context or other signed/roadside options without blocking access.

Older 2020 hiker notes about fallen trees between Fagerön and Näsnaren, attributed to wind and beaver activity, and 2015 notes about beaver/wet brush near Näsnaren are useful route texture, but not current condition reports. No strong current Stage 29 mud-hole or waymarking-confusion report was found.

Do not add OSM relation water-source/viewpoint spur members, Fagerön parking, Fridhem, Djupviks kursgård, or the Hålvetten lake-centroid as route-builder geometry. Draw the continuous Viggaren-Djupviksvägen mainline and keep services/water as separate markers.

Topology caveat: Naturkartan's Stage 29 line ends about 50 m east of the OSM/official Stage 30 continuity point. For stitching to Stage 30, snap to the official/OSM shared Djupviksvägen node around 58.824786, 16.342178.

facilities.name: Viggaren stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start by Lake Viggaren and junction with stage 28. Parking is limited/roadside context rather than a large formal trailhead.

facilities.name: Stage 29 mid-stage spring
facilities.description: Official natural source after about 4 km, matched by OSM spring/drinking-water data near 58.852320, 16.331230. Treat/filter/boil and verify flow before relying on it.

facilities.name: Glindran-Strångsjö road crossing
facilities.description: Road crossing/short road-section context near the mid-stage spring and possible parking. Use caution around pickup/dropoff and do not block the road.

facilities.name: Hjulbo / Hålvetten swim-rest context
facilities.description: Hjulbo / Hålvetten bathing/rest opportunity mentioned by Sörmlandsleden. Pin is moved to route-adjacent Hjulbo/Hålvetten context rather than the lake-centre point; no toilet/shelter was verified and this is not a drinking-water point.

facilities.name: Näsnaren spring/source
facilities.description: Official natural source west/northwest of the Näsnaren shelter; OSM spring/drinking-water data matches nearby at about 58.838182, 16.327674. Treat/filter/boil and expect seasonal variation.

facilities.name: Näsnaren viewpoint/rest detour
facilities.description: Viewpoint/rest context before descending toward Näsnaren, matching Sörmlandsleden route text and OSM viewpoint/bench context.

facilities.name: Näsnaren shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter by Näsnaren; Naturkartan/OSM align closely. Main rest/overnight node on the stage. Older access notes mention rough/private/gated road complications by car, so approach it as a trail shelter rather than a drive-up facility.

facilities.name: Näsnaren shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped fireplace/firepit at or near the shelter. Use only when current fire restrictions allow; do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Näsnaren dry toilet
facilities.description: Pit toilet behind/at the Näsnaren shelter area. OSM maps the toilet separately from the shelter; verify condition on arrival.

facilities.name: Näsnaren suitable tent area
facilities.description: Officially suitable tenting by the shelter. Reports suggest space may be tight, possibly about one tent, while hammock trees are easier; use low-impact one-night camping and keep shoreline/toilet hygiene careful.

facilities.name: No bin at Näsnaren shelter
facilities.description: OSM marks no bin at the Näsnaren shelter and Sörmlandsleden generally expects hikers to carry out waste from shelters.

facilities.name: Fagerön-Näsnaren windfall caveat
facilities.description: Older hiker reports describe many fallen trees between Fagerön and Näsnaren, attributed to wind and beaver activity. Official page currently has no fault report, so treat as a historically recurring-prone spot rather than a confirmed current blockage.

facilities.name: Fagerön municipal bathing place
facilities.description: Municipal natural bathing place with jetty, benches/tables, grill/fireplace, shelter, toilet and bins. 2025 samples were tjänligt with no algal bloom and classification for the 2026 bathing season is excellent; this is not a potable-water claim.

facilities.name: Fagerön shelter and Arknat context
facilities.description: Fagerön has shelter context from Naturkartan/municipal data, and Sörmlandsleden separately reports a new Arknat shelter/rastplats near the bridge/parking from 2025-07-09. Use local signage/Sörmlandsleden maps rather than the inconsistent third-party Arknat coordinate.

facilities.name: Fagerön grill/fireplace
facilities.description: Municipal grill/fireplace. Naturkartan notes no wood shed; check current fire rules and bring fuel only if allowed.

facilities.name: Fagerön bathing-place toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet at the Fagerön bathing/service area. Naturkartan confirms toilet category, but availability may be seasonal or condition-dependent.

facilities.name: Fagerön bridge-side toilet
facilities.description: Second mapped toilet near the bridge/parking side of Fagerön. Verify seasonal opening and condition.

facilities.name: Fagerön bridge-side waste basket
facilities.description: Mapped waste basket at the Fagerön bridge/parking side. Pack out waste if bins are full, removed or seasonal service is absent.

facilities.name: Fagerön tenting caveat
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden lists suitable tenting at Fagerön, but Katrineholm local rules restrict camping/tenting on public places and Fagerön bathing place is municipal public space. Do not tent on the maintained beach/lawn; follow signs and use only appropriate ground clearly outside restricted public-place areas.

facilities.name: Fagerön bathing-place rules
facilities.description: Katrineholm/Naturkartan rules prohibit smoking and dogs at ordinary municipal bathing places, and dogs must be leashed on public places. Follow current signs.

facilities.name: Fagerön bridge parking
facilities.description: Practical parking near the bridge/Fagerön service area. Naturkartan/Stage 30 describe parking about 600-800 m from the bathing/stage-transition area; check local signs and avoid blocking access.

facilities.name: Fagerön bus-stop context
facilities.description: OSM maps a Fagerön Sörmlandstrafiken stop near the Djupviksvägen/route-end area; service appears sparse and Naturkartan found no convenient nearby stops. Check Sörmlandstrafiken live.

facilities.name: Fagerön opposite bus context
facilities.description: Opposite-side Fagerön stop context near the stage end. Verify current line 483/related service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Djupviksnäs bus context
facilities.description: Nearby west-side Sörmlandstrafiken access context. Service is sparse; verify live departures and walking route.

facilities.name: Djupvik bus context
facilities.description: Farther west / complementary-access Sörmlandstrafiken context. Treat as off-route access planning only.

facilities.name: Nytorp bus context for Viggaren
facilities.description: Nearest mapped bus context for the Viggaren start, roughly 1.7 km straight-line with longer walking likely. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Fridhem Outdoor off-route services
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden lists Fridhem Outdoor AB near Hjulbo/Näsnaren/Fagerön, about 1-1.5 km off trail, with 5 rooms/12 beds, food by arrangement, wood-fired sauna and canoe/rowing-boat rental. Verify by SMS/phone/booking before relying; pin is approximate/off-route.

facilities.name: Stage 29 OSM spur caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 3114035 includes short dangling spur members to a water point and a viewpoint/rest point. Keep these as markers/spurs, not part of the through route line.

facilities.name: Djupviksvägen stage transition
facilities.description: Official Stage 30 start and OSM shared Stage 29/30 node align here within a few metres. Naturkartan's Stage 29 line stops slightly east; use this point for route stitching. Official guidance says there is no parking exactly where stage 29 becomes stage 30.

facilities.name: Djupviks kursgård service context
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden still lists Djupviks kursgård as nearby stage-29/30 lodging/service context about 700 m by shortcut or 1.5 km from the stage board, but business-register pages suggest historical/inactive uncertainty. Keep only as verify-before-use/book-by-phone context, not dependable open service.

facilities.name: Näsnaren PFAS fish warning
facilities.description: Katrineholm/Länsstyrelsen advise not eating fish from Näsnaren after PFAS/PFOS findings. Treat as a fish-consumption warning, not a published bathing closure; avoid relying on Näsnaren lake water as casual drinking water, and do not imply ordinary boiling/filtering removes PFAS.

facilities.name: Näsnaren fishing permit context
facilities.description: Fishing in Näsnaren requires a fishing card/rights-holder permission; Jönåkers Häradsallmänning lists fishing-card context and Djupvik boat places. This does not override the PFAS fish-consumption warning.
